report_name: AI-Powered Cyberattacks Target Financial and Government Sectors in Latin America

threat_actors.name: CL-CRI-1131
threat_actors.description: An activity cluster targeting Mexican federal government and transportation organizations. This group uses living-off-the-land techniques, with AI/LLM assistance for script generation and troubleshooting, and shares SOCKS5 proxy and C2 infrastructure with CL-CRI-1163.
threat_actors.goals: Data exfiltration and compromise of government and transportation entities in Mexico.

threat_actors.name: CL-CRI-1163
threat_actors.description: An activity cluster targeting the Brazilian financial sector. This group uses custom malware and job-themed phishing for initial access, leveraging AI/LLMs for operational tasks. It shares SOCKS5 proxy and AI tooling infrastructure with CL-CRI-1131.
threat_actors.goals: Compromise of financial institutions in Brazil, likely for financial gain or data theft.

attack_patterns.name: OS Credential Dumping
attack_patterns.description: The CL-CRI-1131 attacker attempted to dump credentials by accessing the Security Account Manager (SAM) registry hive and the Active Directory database (NTDS.dit).

attack_patterns.name: Security Account Manager
attack_patterns.description: The CL-CRI-1131 attacker attempted to copy the Security Account Manager (SAM) registry hive, eventually succeeding by using a Volume Shadow Copy.

attack_patterns.name: NTDS
attack_patterns.description: The CL-CRI-1131 attacker attempted to copy the Active Directory database (NTDS.dit), eventually succeeding by using a Volume Shadow Copy.

attack_patterns.name: Windows Command Shell
attack_patterns.description: The CL-CRI-1131 attacker used a series of numbered batch scripts, likely generated by an LLM, to automate data collection and other tasks.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: The CL-CRI-1131 attacker used Volume Shadow Copies (VSS) to create a snapshot of the system, which allowed them to access and copy locked files like SAM and NTDS.dit.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: The CL-CRI-1163 campaign is believed to use job-themed phishing attacks to gain initial access to target networks in the Brazilian financial sector.

attack_patterns.name: Proxy
attack_patterns.description: Both CL-CRI-1131 and CL-CRI-1163 campaigns utilize a shared SOCKS5 proxy network to anonymize their traffic and C2 communications.

attack_patterns.name: Dynamic Resolution
attack_patterns.description: The attackers used dynamic DNS services, specifically duckdns.org, for resilient command-and-control infrastructure.

attack_patterns.name: Generative AI
attack_patterns.description: The threat actors used commercial Large Language Models (LLMs) like Claude and GPT-4, accessed via the NextChat interface, to generate malicious scripts and troubleshoot data exfiltration tasks.

tools.name: Claude
tools.description: A commercial Large Language Model (LLM) used by the attackers via the NextChat interface to generate scripts and troubleshoot technical issues during their campaigns.

tools.name: GPT-4.1
tools.description: A commercial Large Language Model (LLM) used by the attackers via the NextChat interface to generate scripts and troubleshoot technical issues during their campaigns.

tools.name: NextChat
tools.description: An open-source tool hosted on attacker infrastructure that provides a web interface to interact with multiple LLMs, used to generate and refine malicious scripts.

tools.name: vssadmin
tools.description: The Windows Volume Shadow Copy Service administrative command-line tool was used by attackers to create a system snapshot, enabling the exfiltration of locked files such as the SAM hive and NTDS.dit.

identities.name: Mexican federal government
identities.description: A Mexican federal government entity was targeted by the CL-CRI-1131 threat actor cluster.

identities.name: Mexican transportation entities
identities.description: Transportation organizations in Mexico were targeted by the CL-CRI-1131 threat actor cluster.

identities.name: Brazilian financial sector
identities.description: The financial sector in Brazil was targeted by the CL-CRI-1163 threat actor cluster.

infrastructure.name: CL-CRI-1131 C2 Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: C2 infrastructure used by the CL-CRI-1131 cluster for data exfiltration, utilizing the dynamic DNS domain m-doxa-apodo.duckdns.org.

infrastructure.name: Shared SOCKS5 Proxy Network
infrastructure.description: A SOCKS5 proxy network shared by both CL-CRI-1131 and CL-CRI-1163 to anonymize their C2 traffic.

infrastructure.name: NextChat AI Tooling Server
infrastructure.description: A server hosting an instance of the NextChat open-source tool on port 3000, used by the attackers to interface with LLMs for script generation.

indicators.name: Volume Shadow Copy Creation via vssadmin
indicators.pattern:
title: Volume Shadow Copy Creation via vssadmin
id: 9c8b7a6d-5f4e-4d3c-2b1a-0987654321fe
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to create a volume shadow copy, a technique used by CL-CRI-1131 to access locked files like SAM and NTDS.dit for credential dumping.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/ai-tool-use-targeting-latam-orgs/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-03
tags:
  - attack.t1003
  - attack.t1490
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'create shadow'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of a volume shadow copy using vssadmin.exe, a technique observed in the CL-CRI-1131 campaign to facilitate credential dumping.
